Pair and rank readers agree: the Mann–Whitney AUROC with half credit for ties is 3491/4316 = 0.8088507877664504. Half-up rounding is 0.81 to two decimals and 0.809 to three decimals. The absolute difference from the printed 0.83 is 1141/53950, which exceeds 0.02. The DeLong 95% interval is 0.7347956138 to 0.8829059617. A stratified bootstrap of 2000 resamples with seed 20261113 has 95% percentile interval 0.7309951344 to 0.8760484245. Both intervals contain 0.83. This is discrimination of released scores

label: CONJECTURE
text: The unrounded five-fold CV AUC that the authors displayed as 0.83 is absent from the public article, the public score sheet, and the pinned scripts. Whether 0.83 displays some other unrounded ROC, and whether the released sheet is that ROC’s input, remains open
